column4: skf-approximants @9047d0d3c: c(theta)_t = 1 iff theta + t alpha mod 1 >= 1 - alpha is sturmianCoding; X_alpha = sturmianSubshift alpha : Subshift Bool Z, proved infinite and Setting.IsMinimal for irrational alpha in (0,1), and equal to the closure of the set of codings over theta in [0,1). The MorseHedlund/Hedlund44/Lothaire input is proved (Dirichlet approximation gives bounded returns of the rotation), not cited. Modules SturmianSubshift + SturmianSubshiftMinimal (c04293088), SturmianSubshiftSetting (505979ccf).
skf-approximants @9047d0d3c: c(theta)_t = 1 iff theta lies in [-(t+1) alpha, -t alpha) mod 1. Module SturmianLanguage (5d4049163).

skf-approximants @9047d0d3c: passing to the closure adds no words (language_sturmianSubshift: the words of length m of X_alpha are the words of codings); the points -j alpha mod 1, 0 <= j <= m, are distinct for irrational alpha, c(theta)_[0,m) is constant between them, and these values are exactly the words of length m. Module SturmianLanguage (5d4049163).

skf-approximants @9047d0d3c: c(theta)_t = floor(theta+(t+1)alpha) - floor(theta+t alpha), and for theta in [0,1) the word c(theta)_[0,m) has floor(theta + m alpha) ones, with m alpha - 1 < floor(theta + m alpha) < m alpha + 1 (formalized, SturmianSubshift c04293088 + SturmianLanguage 5d4049163).
